metadata.title: P = W conjectures for varieties with nilpotent fundamental group
metadata.abstract: We prove the cohomological and the geometric $P=W$ conjectures for the moduli spaces of $G$-Higgs bundles and $G$-local systems on any smooth complex projective variety $X$ with nilpotent fundamental group, and any connected complex reductive group $G$. To the best of our knowledge, our results provide the first instances of $P=W$ conjectures beyond curves and abelian varieties. Finally, we provide examples of our theorem for classical groups: as a byproduct of this analysis we investigate when symplectic resolutions of the corresponding character varieties exist.
